name: Nialamide

own_problems.text: Pulled from the market in United States and 4 other countries, first in 1974 — for liver harm

similar.name: Isoniazid
problems: Carries a boxed warning in United States — for liver harm and stomach and gut problems

summary: Nialamide was removed from the market in the United States and four other countries starting in 1974 because of liver harm [3]. A small computer model, rather than testing on people, gave the drug a medium risk score of 63 for the liver and a low risk score of 20 for the heart [M]. Additionally, a related drug named Isoniazid has a boxed warning in the United States for liver damage and harm to the digestive system [4].
